ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: r5-03 rack tail-latency spike detected (95th=420ms) - affecting fractional slices

alex: saw this. looks like repeated short spikes tied to slot churn, not steady GPU util

maria: yup, observed a 'slot swirl' pattern — many small tenants bouncing warm slots -> kvcache churn -> tail latency

sandeep: can we pin the offending tenants to a temporary dedicated carveout while we investigate? cheaper than full reprovisioning

lee: cost question — carving a small fractional dedicated slice for 2-4 racks increases reserved cost by ~4-6% for that region, depending on burst caps

alex: quick telemetry snippet I ran: `curl -s https://telemetry.internal/rack/r5-03/metrics | jq '.[] | select(.name=="tail_latency")'`
```
{"time":"2026-02-18T02:44:10Z","slot":"s91","tenant":"b2","p95":420}
{"time":"2026-02-18T02:44:12Z","slot":"s32","tenant":"a7","p95":410}
```

maria: exact. both tenants have short hot loops that regenerate KV prefixes. KVCACHE missrate spikes when those tenants bounce slots

sandeep: config idea: enable micro-anchoring for these hot tenants + apply soft-segmentation policy so their allocations prefer the same physical slice for 10m

alex: micro-anchoring patch (proposal):
```
policy:
  micro_anchor:
    enabled: true
    prefer_same_slice_for: 10m
    eviction_backoff: 30s
```

lee: looks reasonable. what about routing fallback? if dedicated carveout fills, we need an automatic fallback to a quantized lower-cost model (quantized-2) to preserve latency SLOs

maria: agree. add routing rule: prefer anchor, else fallback to quantized-2 in same AZ, else cross-AZ with hedged calls

alex: quick risk: anchoring increases fragmentation. we should canary on 1 rack, measure tail drop and fragmentation metric (free_slots_pct)

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance window tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC for r5 cluster - avoid big config churn during window

sandeep: canary plan: 1) micro-anchor on r5-03 (rack) 2) soft-segmentation carve for tenants a7,b2 for 2 hours 3) add quantized fallback for routing 4) monitor p95, free_slots_pct, kvcache_miss

lee: who owns rollout? I can run the canary tonight if alex + maria are ok to be on-call for 30m after

alex: I’ll be available. maria?

maria: I’ll watch telemetry. if p95 doesn't drop by >=20% after 15m we rollback

sandeep: will prepare cost delta estimate — expect +5% on reserved commit if we keep carveout for >24h

lee: ok done. tagging @maria @alex @sandeep. :thumbsup:

alex: leaving a quick playbook note here for postmortem if useful:
- timestamp incident
- attach p95 vs kvcache_miss plots
- record which tenant pinned
- decision: carveout duration + cost delta

maria: added to infra/incident-log. thanks.

lee: will run canary at 22:45 UTC to avoid ops-bot maintenance window. report back after 30m

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled by lee: micro-anchor patch -> r5-03 at 2026-02-18T22:45:00Z

alex: great, standing by. :eyes:
